title: Practice Set 1 — Dynamics MCQ Drill
notes:
Q1. Newton's first law of motion is also called the law of:
Answer: Inertia

Q2. The SI unit of force is:
Answer: newton (kg·m/s²)

Q3. Momentum is the product of:
Answer: mass and velocity (p = mv)

Q4. The impulse of a force equals:
Answer: the change in momentum (FΔt = Δp)

Q5. Action and reaction forces always act on:
Answer: two different bodies

Q6. The coefficient of kinetic friction is generally ______ the coefficient of static friction.
Answer: less than

Q7. The force of friction between two surfaces is directly proportional to:
Answer: the normal reaction

Q8. A gun fires a bullet; the backwards force on the gun is explained by:
Answer: conservation of linear momentum

Q9. The torque of a force about a point is zero when the force acts:
Answer: along the line through the pivot (perpendicular distance d = 0)

Q10. The angle of repose on a plane is related to friction by:
Answer: tanθ = μ
